metadata.title: The Step-Mother's Trust
metadata.subtitle: On my 25th birthday, my late mother's trust had $412 left—and my stepmother just bought a Tuscan vineyard.

nodes.text: 04:00 PM · Your 25th birthday—the day your late mother’s $1.2M trust vests. Your trust banker texts urgently.
Happy birthday, Quinn—I’m so sorry to say this, but your trust balance is $412.40. Four "emergency medical" wires totaling $1.18M were drawn last year.
Emergency medical?! I wasn’t even sick last year! Who authorized those wires?!

nodes.transcript: [grave] Your stepmother Camille submitted signed custodial forms—and every single wire routed through a holding company in Florence that just bought a vineyard.

nodes.text: Tell the realtor the Tuscany deed is finalized—Arthur still thinks I bought it with my own alimony!
Happy 25th, sweetheart! Hurry downstairs for your birthday dinner—I bought you a gorgeous silk scarf!

nodes.prompt: Fifty guests and Dad are waiting downstairs. How do you prepare?

options.label: Print the 4 wire receipts & fake invoices
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Grant, email me all four wire receipts with the Florence shell company name.

options.label: Have the bank flag fraud & freeze the villa
options.player_reply_text: Flag all four medical forms as forged right now. Let the bank’s fraud team trace Tuscany.

nodes.text: Sent. Also notice the clinic name on her "medical" receipts—that clinic closed in 2019.
FRAUD ALERT TRIGGERED: International banking compliance freezes Camille’s Florence holding account—and notifies Italian authorities!
Quinn, why is Camille screaming at her phone in the kitchen? Come down, we’re about to cut the cake.
Put on a smile, Quinn. Your father hates ungrateful scenes on birthdays.

nodes.headline: A Scarf for $1.2 Million
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Camille hands you a $40 scarf in front of fifty guests—and you plug your laptop into the dining hall projector.

nodes.text: 06:45 PM · Dining Hall. Camille raises her champagne glass, smiling sweetly at Dad.
To Quinn! I’ve cared for you like my own child—and today I hope you cherish this scarf.
Thank you, Camille. Though I’m a little more curious about the $1.18 million vineyard you bought with my dead mother’s trust.
Turn off the projector!! Don’t let Arthur see the Florence wire!!
Camille?! What is Quinn talking about? You told me your brother bought that vineyard!

nodes.transcript: [on speaker] Mr. Hải, this is Trust Banking. Your wife forged four medical claims from a clinic that closed in 2019 to empty Quinn’s trust.

nodes.prompt: Camille drops her glass on the marble floor. How do you end her reign?

options.label: Press felony embezzlement charges tonight
options.player_reply_text: I’m not settling quietly, Dad. She stole from my mother’s grave. Let the prosecutors handle her.

options.label: Force her to sign the vineyard over to YOU
options.player_reply_text: Sign the Tuscany deed over to me plus interest tonight—or explain the fake clinic to a judge.

nodes.text: Your father removes his wedding ring and sets it beside the birthday cake without a single word.
ESTATE RECOVERED: Camille signs over the $1.6M appreciating Tuscan vineyard—and Dad files for divorce before midnight!
I’m so sorry I was blind to her, Quinn. Your mother would be proud of how fiercely you fought.
Best 25th birthday gift I could ask for: the truth.

nodes.headline: Cheers to Twenty-Five
nodes.teaser_text: While packing Camille’s desk, Dad finds a second forged signature—she had tried to take out a life insurance policy on HIM.

nodes.text: 8:20 PM · Dad’s Study. The life insurance form Dad just found in Camille’s desk changes everything.
Quinn… my hands won’t stop shaking. Camille forged my signature on a $5 MILLION life insurance policy—with HER as sole beneficiary!
She emptied my late mother’s trust for a Tuscan vineyard, and now she took out a $5M policy on YOUR life?!

nodes.caption: FORGED POLICY APPLICATION · $5,000,000 Term Life Policy — Beneficiary: Camille V. (Notarized without Dad present).

nodes.text: Urgent alert, Quinn! Camille just instructed the Italian real-estate broker to rush-sell the Tuscan vineyard for cash by tomorrow noon!
Once the vineyard wire hits my Zurich account I’m on the 6 AM flight—

nodes.transcript: [typing quickly] Quinn, if that Tuscan sale closes before we file an international fraud freeze, your mother’s trust money disappears into Zurich!

nodes.prompt: Camille is fleeing at 6 AM with your late mother’s trust! How do you stop her?

options.label: File an international fraud hold in Tuscany
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Grant, transmit the trust-theft police report straight to the Italian notary handling the vineyard!

options.label: Freeze vineyard + alert police about insurance
options.player_reply_text: Freeze the Tuscan closing AND hand detectives the forged $5M life insurance policy—put a flight-risk alert on her passport!

nodes.text: SALE FROZEN: The Italian notary halts the cash closing immediately under EU anti-money-laundering law.
PASSPORT FLAGGED: Detectives classify Camille as a high-flight-risk felony suspect—airport customs is alerted!
I can’t believe I defended her for three years while she robbed my daughter and plotted against me.
Why did my Italian broker just text that the vineyard escrow is locked?! What did you do, Quinn?!

nodes.headline: Trapped Before Takeoff
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Camille races to the airport anyway—unaware detectives are already waiting at Gate 12.

nodes.text: 5:25 AM · International Terminal. Camille pulls a designer carry-on toward security.
Tell your father I’ll sign the vineyard back over if he drops the insurance complaint! Don’t ruin my life over a misunderstanding!
Forging my dad’s signature on a $5M life insurance policy isn’t a "misunderstanding," Camille.
Good news—we traced the exact wire that bought the Tuscan vineyard back to your late mother’s trust account. Zero doubt in court!
Why is the passport scanner flashing red at customs—
Detective just called me! Customs stopped Camille at the international departure gate—and found $40,000 in undeclared cash in her purse!

nodes.transcript: [printer humming] Even better—the notary who illegally stamped Camille’s forged papers just flipped witness! He’s testifying against her in exchange for immunity!

nodes.prompt: Camille is in custody and offers to sign the vineyard deed back immediately! Your move?

options.label: Take the vineyard deed & let prosecutors act
options.player_reply_text: Have her sign the full restitution deed back to Mom’s trust—and let the prosecutor handle the criminal forgery.

options.label: Reclaim vineyard + her $40K airport cash
options.player_reply_text: Reclaim the vineyard deed AND apply the $40K cash she tried to smuggle toward the legal fees and interest!

nodes.text: RESTITUTION LOCKED: Camille signs the transfer deed in the interrogation room as the DA files formal charges.
EVERY CENT RECOVERED: Your late mother’s trust is restored to 100% plus accrued interest—not one dollar lost.
I’m filing for an annulment based on fraud this morning, Quinn. And I owe you the biggest apology of my life.
Just glad you’re safe, Dad. Come home—let’s get some real coffee.

nodes.headline: Freezing Tuscany
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Watch the international escrow wire restore your mother’s trust dollar for dollar.

nodes.text: 11:30 AM · Private Trust Bank. Mr. Grant slides the international wire confirmation across his mahogany desk.
Official confirmation just landed from Florence—the Tuscan property equity has cleared straight back into your 25th-birthday trust!

nodes.caption: TRUST RESTORATION COMPLETE · Full principal + $142,000 accrued interest returned to Quinn.

nodes.text: From $412 back to every penny your mother saved for you. And I had my lawyer remove my own co-signer access—it’s 100% yours alone.
Thank you, Dad. And thank you, Mr. Grant—for refusing to look the other way when Camille showed up with forged papers.
My lawyer says fraud plus forged insurance carries three years minimum—

nodes.transcript: [voice warm, emotional] Happy belated 25th birthday, sweetheart. Tonight I’m cooking your mom’s favorite dinner—just the two of us.

nodes.prompt: Your late mother’s trust is 100% back in your hands! What’s your first move?

options.label: Lock 80% in index funds & fund your dream
options.player_reply_text: Mr. Grant, place 80% in a protected index trust—and I’m using the rest to launch my own architecture studio!

options.label: Launch studio + a scholarship in Mom’s name
options.player_reply_text: Launch my studio—AND dedicate the recovered $142K interest to an annual Arts Scholarship in my mother’s name!

nodes.text: SMART HEIR: Mr. Grant nods approvingly—"Your mother would be so proud of how level-headed you are."
TEARS OF PRIDE: Dad wipes his eyes—"That is the purest way to honor her memory, Quinn."
All paperwork executed. Happy 25th birthday, Quinn.
See you at 7 PM—I already bought the birthday cake we missed.

nodes.headline: Cheers To Twenty-Five
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Finale): Blow out the candles on a restored legacy and a healed bond with Dad.

nodes.text: 7:30 PM · Family Dining Room. Twenty-five warm candles glow on a cake beside your mother’s framed portrait.
Annulment finalized by the judge this afternoon. The house finally feels like our home again.
And your homemade soup tastes even better than I remembered, Dad.
Quick birthday gift update: the Italian court officially dismissed Camille’s last appeal. Your trust is 100% untouchable.
I should have left that trust fund alone—

nodes.transcript: [candlelight flickering] Make a wish, Quinn. Whatever you build at 25, I’m right behind you—no distractions, no blind spots ever again.

nodes.text: Already made my wish—and it’s already coming true.

nodes.prompt: Your final wish as you blow out the 25th birthday candles:

options.label: Wish for peace, family & a fearless 25
options.player_reply_text: To Mom’s love, to Dad’s health, and to a fearless new chapter at twenty-five!

options.label: Take Dad on a real trip to Italy next spring
options.player_reply_text: Next spring, Dad—let’s take a father-daughter trip to Italy ourselves, on Mom’s restored legacy!

nodes.text: CANDLES OUT: Warm laughter fills the room as the shadow of the stepmother vanishes for good.
POETIC JUSTICE: Dad bursts out laughing—"Now THAT is how you reclaim Tuscany!"
Enjoy the cake, you two. Always here whenever you need a trustworthy banker.
Love you, kiddo. Happy twenty-five.

nodes.headline: FINALE · Legacy Reclaimed
nodes.teaser_text: You exposed the stepmother’s fraud, saved your father, and reclaimed every cent of your mother’s love.
